# Could COVID-19 Increase the Risk for Alzheimer's Disease?

> The SARS-CoV-2 virus, which is the cause of COVID-19, enters the brain and can cause damage there. Pathologies resulting from the virus can manifest as many symptoms, including neural and psychiatric ones.
